# link11waap_actions (Data Source)

Lists actions in a configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Actions Data Source

data "link11waap_config" "main" {}

# List all actions in the configuration.
data "link11waap_actions" "all" {
  config_id = data.link11waap_config.main.id
}

# Look up a single action by name.
data "link11waap_actions" "by_name" {
  config_id = data.link11waap_config.main.id
  name      = "Block Forbidden"
}

output "actions" {
  value = data.link11waap_actions.all.actions
}

output "action_names" {
  value = [for a in data.link11waap_actions.all.actions : a.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_id` (String) Configuration ID.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Action ID. If specified, only the action with this ID will be returned.
- `name` (String) Action Name. If specified, only the action with this name will be returned.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (Attributes List) List of actions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
